help.stillStuck: Still stuck? Drop us a line — we usually reply within a working day.

tiers.a:
Three flat per-organisation tiers — no per-agent fees. Operator (€49/month) for solo agents and 1–3 person offices. Team (€199/month, includes 10 agents) for the mid-market wedge. Business (€599/month, unlimited agents) for 20+ agent firms.

Compare with Whise: at 10 agents you'd pay them €890/month for Expert tier. DEUS costs €199 — €8,292 cheaper per year.

change-tier.a: Yes, instantly. Upgrades are prorated to the day; downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle. We never lock you into a higher tier.

annual-discount.q: Do you offer annual billing or discounts?
annual-discount.a: Yes — annual billing saves 15% across all tiers. Design partners (first 3 BE/FR agencies) get 6 months free in exchange for weekly feedback, then standard pricing applies.

payment-methods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment-methods.a: Credit card, SEPA direct debit, and bank transfer (annual contracts only). All billing runs through Stripe. VAT is automatically handled per EU country.

from-whise.q: How do I migrate from Whise?
from-whise.a:
For design partners, the founder personally handles the migration — usually within 48 hours of you sending the Whise export. We import contacts, properties, deals, agent records, and historic notes. Email integrations and active drip campaigns are re-wired on a follow-up call.

For non-design-partner customers post-launch, we provide a self-service importer + onboarding call.

data-import.q: What data can you import from my current CRM?
data-import.a: Contacts (with custom fields), properties, deals/transactions, listings (with photos), agent accounts, activity history, and email threads where the format supports it. We've imported from Whise, Realworks, Pipedrive, HubSpot, and several local NL/BE/FR tools.

onboarding-time.a: A 5-agent agency is fully running in 1–2 days. A 20-agent agency: 3–5 days including team training. Most of that is YOUR review of the imported data, not our technical work.

training.a: Yes — included in all paid tiers. Live group training (90 min, recorded) plus written guides in 5 languages. We also pair-screen with each agency owner for the first week to spot any workflow friction.

funda-integration.q: Does DEUS integrate with Funda, Immoweb, ImmoScout24?
funda-integration.a: Funda + Immoweb integrations are live (sprint 2 of EU real-estate launch). ImmoScout24 (DE), Idealista (ES), SeLoger (FR), and Logic-Immo (FR) are on the public roadmap, prioritised by first paying customer in each market.

ai-features.a:
Three AI capabilities bundled in every tier (not paywalled):
• AI contact enrichment — Claude Haiku derives industry, ICP-fit score, and contact summary
• AI lead scoring — 0–100 score per contact based on behavior
• AI command bar — natural language search + actions across the CRM

No per-message AI fees. We absorb the model cost in your subscription.

whatsapp.q: How does the WhatsApp click-to-chat work?
whatsapp.a:
Every contact with a valid international phone number gets a WhatsApp button on their detail page. Click it → pick from 5 pre-built templates (open-house follow-up, viewing confirmation, offer update, document request, intro) → WhatsApp opens with the message pre-filled and personalised.

Future sprint adds full WhatsApp Business API (send + receive inside DEUS).

template-customization.q: Can I customise the WhatsApp / email / drip templates?
template-customization.a: Email + drip templates: yes, fully editable per organisation. WhatsApp templates: currently 5 system defaults; per-organisation customisation is planned for sprint 4. Tell us if you need it sooner.

gdpr.a:
Yes, by design. Concretely:
• Article 15 (access): one-click data export
• Article 17 (erasure): 30-day deletion window with verifier
• Article 30 (records of processing): living register in /settings/gdpr
• AES-256-GCM at-rest encryption for PII
• SHA-256 hash-chained audit log (tamper-evident)
• Signed DPA available on request

Every action that touches personal data is recorded with the actor, timestamp, and change diff.

data-residency.a: Supabase EU region (Frankfurt or Amsterdam, depending on the project). No data leaves the EU. Backups are EU-stored too. We never use a US-hosted database, log shipper, or analytics provider for customer data.

export-data.q: Can I export all my data if I cancel?
export-data.a: Yes — at any time, including post-cancellation (7-day grace window). One-click JSON export of every row + file we hold about you. The export format is documented so you can self-import to another CRM.

retention.a: Active customer data: retained while your subscription is active. After cancellation: 7-day grace window for export, then deleted. Audit logs: retained for 7 years per EU compliance norms, even after account deletion (legal requirement). Personal data inside audit logs is hashed-not-stored after the cancellation grace window.

contract-length.a: Monthly is the default — no minimum term, cancel anytime. Annual contracts get 15% off and the predictability some agencies prefer. No 3-year contracts.

support-included.a:
Operator tier: email support, response within 1 working day.
Team tier: email + chat, response within 4 working hours.
Business tier: email + chat + scheduled video calls, response within 1 working hour during EU office hours.

Design partners: WhatsApp/Signal direct access to the founder, response within 1 hour any working day.

cancel-anytime.a: Yes. Monthly plans: cancel from /settings/billing, takes effect at end of current period. Annual plans: cancel anytime, no auto-renewal at term end. We do not retain payment method after cancellation.

design-partner.q: What does it mean to be a design partner?
design-partner.a:
First 3 Belgian agencies (5–20 agents) get 6 months free Team tier in exchange for:
• A 30-minute weekly call with the founder for product feedback
• Permission to use your name + a testimonial after month 3
• Willingness to try features 1–2 weeks before general release

In return you get: roadmap influence, direct line to the founder, and €1,194 worth of free Team tier. After month 6 you continue at standard pricing or churn freely.
